programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Mina Harigae
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: Tadej Pogacar : Anatomy of a Goat
programme.desc: "Tadej Pogacar : Anatomy of a Goat" décrypte la domination du champion cycliste slovène. Ce documentaire analyse ses capacités physiques hors norme (VO2 Max record) et sa polyvalence unique, capable de briller sur les pavés des classiques comme en haute montagne. Le film montre comment ce coureur réécrit l'histoire pour s'imposer comme le véritable GOAT du cyclisme moderne.

programme.title: Sambo : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Découvrez des épreuves du Championnat du monde de Sambo, un art martial apparu en URSS dans les années 1930, fruit d'un mélange de judo, de boxe et de lutte. La première édition a eu lieu en 1973, et elle regroupe à chaque édition les athlètes de 11 pays. A noter que les femmes n'ont participé qu'à une seule édition en 1983. La Russie et l'URSS sont les seules vainqueurs de l'épreuve, excepté en 1997 où la Géorgie l'a remporté à domicile.

programme.title: 30 for 30: Phi Slama Jama
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Tadej Pogacar : Anatomy of a Goat
programme.desc: "Tadej Pogacar : Anatomy of a Goat" décrypte la domination du champion cycliste slovène. Ce documentaire analyse ses capacités physiques hors norme (VO2 Max record) et sa polyvalence unique, capable de briller sur les pavés des classiques comme en haute montagne. Le film montre comment ce coureur réécrit l'histoire pour s'imposer comme le véritable GOAT du cyclisme moderne.

programme.title: Lyon | Saut d'obstacles
programme.desc: A suivre une étape de la Coupe du monde de saut d'obstacles, un circuit indoor international d'équitation. Se déroulant tous les ans depuis 1978 sous l'égide de la Fédération équestre internationale, ce circuit est le plus prestigieux de cette discipline. Les meilleurs cavaliers et chevaux passent par des circuits de sélection organisés tout au long de l'année partout dans le monde, et les plus performants se retrouvent pour une finale internationale.

programme.title: Sambo : Championnat du monde
programme.desc: Découvrez des épreuves du Championnat du monde de Sambo, un art martial apparu en URSS dans les années 1930, fruit d'un mélange de judo, de boxe et de lutte. La première édition a eu lieu en 1973, et elle regroupe à chaque édition les athlètes de 11 pays. A noter que les femmes n'ont participé qu'à une seule édition en 1983. La Russie et l'URSS sont les seules vainqueurs de l'épreuve, excepté en 1997 où la Géorgie l'a remporté à domicile.

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Atlas, la otra pasión
programme.desc: Docu-reality sobre la vida y la historia de un club de fútbol oficial. Se trata de un club muy particular, ATLAS el último de los últimos de la primera división D. El Club Atlético Atlas es quien por haber quedado último en El Campeonato de Primera División D, perdió la afiliación a AFA por un año y durante ese período perdió también a los jugadores, cuerpo técnico, camisetas, pelotas, redes. programme.title: 30 for 30: Phi Slama Jama
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter
programme.desc: SportsCenter (Sports). The latest news, highlights and inside information from every corner of the sports world is presented each day on «SportsCenter,» ESPN's first-ever program when the network debuted in September of 1979. The flagship series airs an evening edition and a brand new late-night show each weekday before the stage is cleared for a live «SportsCenter» morning block that emphasizes fast-paced, highlights-driven reports and what's new on social media platforms

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: Playing Lessons From the Pros: Mina Harigae
programme.desc: Playing Lessons From the Pros (Sports). Imagine playing a casual round of golf with a legendary player such as Jack Nicklaus, Arnold Palmer, Nick Faldo, Ray Floyd, Colin Montgomerie, Juli Inkster and Laura Davies? Those are just a few of the former greats and current stars of the PGA and LPGA tours who have taken viewers inside the ropes as they make their way around a course, discussing such things as shot setup, club selection, strategy and other helpful hints and tips. It's a priceless lesson, a chance to dissect a pro's thought process as he or she executes all manner of shots

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio

programme.title: ⋗ Sunday NFL Countdown
programme.desc: Sunday NFL Countdown (Sports). This Sunday pregame staple debuted in 1985 and soon became a signature ESPN series. Host Mike Greenberg introduces the features and directs the storylines associated with the day's games, joined by a roster of analysts highlighted by ex-NFL players, coaches and executives including Tedy Bruschi, Randy Moss, Alex Smith, and Rex Ryan. Adam Schefter deliver breaking news and injury updates, while reporters at game sites set the scenes

programme.title: ⋗ SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt
programme.desc: SportsCenter With Scott Van Pelt (Sports). SVP's up at midnight and bringing his unique perspective on games people play to «SportsCenter» viewers. The hourlong, late-night show is driven by the host's self-deprecating wit and passion for sports, with featured elements, including Van Pelt's nightly «1 Big Thing» commentary and a weekly look back at the moments that drove bettors wild in «Bad Beats.» The show also delivers what «SportsCenter» fans are used to – news and highlights, guests and interviews – but in a different, fast-paced and insightful way

programme.title: NFL Matchup: Week 9
programme.desc: NFL Matchup (Sports). An NFL Films production, «NFL Matchup» is definitely a show for football junkies. Unlike traditional football preview programs, this one gives fans an in-depth look at some of Sunday's games by breaking down the strategy and tactics – the Xs and Os – through the exclusive use of team-supplied footage. That type of film study is a forte of former NFL player Matt Bowen and NFL Films producer Greg Cosell, whose work is featured here alongside host Sal Paolantonio
